mapper.select: SELECT approve_status, count(*) FROM transfer_in WHERE is_deleted=FALSE GROUP BY approve_status

SELECT ti.id, ti.code, ti.source_code, ti.transfer_direction, ti.approve_status, ti.invalid_status, ti.bill_date, ti.out_warehouse_id, ti.out_warehouse_name, ti.in_warehouse_id, ti.in_warehouse_name, tid.sku_id, tid.sku_no, tid.qty, tid.out_warehouse_location, tid.remark, tid.plan_qty, tid.source_detail_id FROM transfer_in ti INNER JOIN transfer_in_detail tid ON ti.id=tid.main_id AND tid.is_deleted=FALSE WHERE ti.is_deleted=FALSE
